title: Target Budget Allocation
description: A project manager has a set of available task costs and a target total budget. They want to find all unique combinations of task costs that sum up to the target budget. Each task cost can be chosen an unlimited number of times.
constraints: All elements in the task costs are distinct positive integers.
input_format: An array of positive integers representing task costs and an integer representing the target budget.
output_format: A list of lists containing all unique combinations of task costs that sum up to the target budget.

examples.explanation: 2 + 2 + 3 = 7 and 7 = 7. These are the only valid combinations.
Multiple valid combinations sum up to 8 using the available costs.
No combination of the available cost can reach the target budget.
